description: Builds an address voltage from four clock dividers read as the bits of a number, with a gate output for each bit

params.text: Picks what the ones bit of the number follows: OFF, ON, or one of the sixteen clock dividers C1 to C16
Picks what the twos bit of the number follows: OFF, ON, or one of the sixteen clock dividers C1 to C16
Picks what the fours bit of the number follows: OFF, ON, or one of the sixteen clock dividers C1 to C16
Picks what the eights bit of the number follows: OFF, ON, or one of the sixteen clock dividers C1 to C16
Sets the address space the number is spread over, 4 to 32; use 16 to address TD4
Sets the counter value a reset jumps to, 0 to 32
Inverts the ones bit before the number is built and before it reaches its gate output
Inverts the twos bit before the number is built and before it reaches its gate output
Inverts the fours bit before the number is built and before it reaches its gate output
Inverts the eights bit before the number is built and before it reaches its gate output
Inverts all sixteen divider gates carried on the divider output

inputs.text: Each rising edge advances the counter the dividers are taken from
A rising edge sets the counter to the offset and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the offset the counter resets to, 3.2 counts per volt over 0-10V, and overrides the Ofs knob while patched
Selects what the ones bit follows, a quarter of a volt per position, and a negative voltage selects by its size and switches the inversion on
Selects what the twos bit follows, a quarter of a volt per position, and a negative voltage selects by its size and switches the inversion on
Selects what the fours bit follows, a quarter of a volt per position, and a negative voltage selects by its size and switches the inversion on
Selects what the eights bit follows, a quarter of a volt per position, and a negative voltage selects by its size and switches the inversion on

outputs.text: The number built from the four bits as a voltage: the number divided by the size, times 10
A 1ms trigger whenever the address voltage changes
Carries 10V while the ones bit is high and 0V while it is low
Carries 10V while the twos bit is high and 0V while it is low
Carries 10V while the fours bit is high and 0V while it is low
Carries 10V while the eights bit is high and 0V while it is low
All sixteen clock dividers at once, one per channel, 10V while that divider is high

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
